title: Naruto Fans, Get Ready: New Anime News Is Coming!
summary: Have you been waiting forever for new Naruto anime? You're not alone. After more than three years of silence, there's finally some news. Back in 2023, the franchise announced four special episodes with modern animation to celebrate Naruto's 20th anniversary. They were supposed to come out in September 2023, but got delayed to make them better. Fans even wondered if the whole series would get a remake. Then... nothing. But on Sept. 29, 2026, two official Naruto accounts on X confirmed that the big announcement at New York Comic Con will be about the new anime. The panel, called "Naruto: What's Next," happens on Oct. 10 from 6 to 7 p.m. EDT. Fans there — or watching online — will be "the first to witness the latest news of the New Naruto TV Anime Limited Series." Why the long wait? The animation studio Pierrot has been busy with Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War, which ends Oct. 26. Maybe now they're free to focus on Naruto. Whether it's just four episodes or a full remake, fans are ready. The search for Team 7 has begun!
why_it_matters: Waiting years for something you love teaches patience, and it also shows how fan communities keep a story alive — the same way you might follow a favorite game or book series and share news with your friends.

background_read: Naruto is a Japanese comic and cartoon (anime) series about a young ninja named Naruto Uzumaki and his friends, and it grew into one of the most popular anime in the world.
New York Comic Con (a huge yearly fan event in New York) is where studios often show trailers and share big news about comics, anime, and games.
Anime fans are used to long waits: studios in Japan often work on several shows at once, so a new series can take years to be ready.
Article_Structure: WHO: Naruto fans around the world, two official Naruto accounts on X, and the animation studio Pierrot.
WHAT: After more than three years of silence, the official accounts confirmed that a big announcement about the new Naruto anime is coming at a fan panel.
WHERE: At New York Comic Con in the panel 'Naruto: What's Next,' and online for fans watching from home.

WHY: The four special episodes announced in 2023 were delayed and then nothing happened, so fans feared the project was dead — now they will finally hear the 'latest news of the New Naruto TV Anime Limited Series.'

perspectives.description: This is a dream come true: after three years of no news, a real announcement is finally scheduled, and fans can watch it online or in person.
Some are annoyed that the studio stayed quiet for so long and is now only promising 'news about news,' instead of showing the actual episodes.

Animation studios juggle several shows at once, and Pierrot finishing Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War may simply free up the team's time — so the timing of the announcement may just be about schedules, not about teasing fans.
